answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 18576 Country: India Title: Breastfeeding to a baby after two years Question: Asslamu Alaikum,Hazrat Mufti Sahab, Kindly advce maximum time for breast feeding for a girl child?Is breast feeding more than two years haram? Shukriya Answer ID: 18576 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 20/18/B=1431) According to preferred opinion, the period of breastfeeding to an infant is two years; breastfeeding after tow years is unlawful: والوالدات يرضعن أولادهن حولين كاملين لمن أراد أن يتم الرضاعة ( البقرۃ 233 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
